name: go-static-embedded-binary
body: kalide must be written in Go and ship as a single self-contained static binary per supported target — darwin/arm64, darwin/amd64, windows/amd64, windows/arm64, linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 — each gated purely on GitHub-hosted native runner availability, with no external runtime or network dependency at run time. Only the core of the tool is embedded via Go embed: the vendored reveal.js runtime, the core page shells (deck, error, gallery), the minimal `kalide init` seed scaffold and the static, text-only `AGENTS.md` scaffold guide files (requirements.requirement.agent-authoring) written verbatim by the scaffolding commands (`kalide init`, `kalide init <path>`, `kalide init-library`); the embedded core carries no brand (global.constraint.core-unbranded). Templates, themes, fonts, logos and other media must never be embedded; they are read from the resolved library root (the configured `templates:` path, else the local `templates/`; see global.constraint.no-embedded-template-assets).
